unresumableConversation.note: Before, a failed New Document leaves its dialog open, so the runs stop there and Runtime and Memory Spaces were not reached.

followUps: With workspace or centralized storage, a tab whose Agent is not loaded used the DSH launch directory as its root on main; the fix routes it to the conversation workspace. Entries saved the old way stay in the launch directory.
A full Documents capacity in such a tab runs under a task Agent that archives the least recently used Document first, as the conversation Agent does (tests/rpc.spec.ts).
Automatic Provider placement for a new Memory Space runs under a task Agent in that state (tests/rpc.spec.ts).
The dashboard aligns such a session with its registry workspace (tests/view-management.spec.ts).
Archived sessions keep their place in the DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.2 registries, so they route to their workspace too.
